# ttt2 - ReXGlue recompiled project (host executable). Generated by `rexglue init` (SDK 0.10.0) and edited.
#
# This builds only with the ReXGlue SDK available (REXSDK_DIR or an installed package) and with the
# player's own game files in recomp/game/ for the codegen step. See docs/DEVELOPMENT.md.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(ttt2 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

include(generated/rexglue.cmake)

set(TTT2_SOURCES
    src/main.cpp
    src/ttt2_app.cpp
    src/stub_counter.cpp
)

if(WIN32)
    add_executable(ttt2 WIN32 ${TTT2_SOURCES})
else()
    add_executable(ttt2 ${TTT2_SOURCES})
endif()

rexglue_setup_target(ttt2)

# rex/rex_app.h pulls in the SDK's ImGui-based UI headers; in a source-tree build (REXSDK_DIR) the
# ImGui target is not propagated to consumers, so link it explicitly for the include directories.
if(TARGET imgui::imgui)
    target_link_libraries(ttt2 PRIVATE imgui::imgui)
endif()
